diagnosis.cause: The official provider path truncated each venue before active RuntimeBinding symbols were considered and the provider dispatcher then applied a second global cap. The first retained TWSE record was 00400A, while active paper symbol 2330 was outside the bounded prefix.
diagnosis.identity_gap: Official TWSE rows persist as 2330.TWSE, while the active RuntimeBinding reads 2330.TW. Exact lookup could therefore continue serving a separately persisted legacy 2330.TW series rather than the new official exchange series.
immutable_log_facts: The bounded refresh completed and advanced receipt/projection readback.
The admitted source identity was TWSE symbol 00400A rather than active symbol 2330.
The paper-signal-producer was the sole unhealthy component after repeated 2330.TW Source snapshot reads.

producer_admission.cause: The Source read alias selected the correct official snapshot but exposed its stored .TWSE symbol instead of the RuntimeBinding execution identity required by strict producer admission.

review_rejection_reproduction.disposition: Do not merge or deploy the rejected head; the correction must preserve the official stored identity while emitting the requested execution alias in the read-only response.

implementation.owned_layer: Bounded Taiwan official record selection, Source snapshot read aliases, and nonprod deployment proof/diagnostics.
behavior: The deployment reads only the durable RuntimeBinding volume through a one-off runtime-manager container and extracts unique active paper Taiwan symbols without mutating bindings.

The source-ingest service receives those symbols as priority metadata; the Taiwan official adapter stable-partitions matching TWSE/TPEx rows before the unchanged per-venue and global max-record bounds.
The provider dispatcher fails closed when active symbols exceed the cap or an active Taiwan symbol is absent from the official payload.

Read-only snapshot lookup maps .TW to .TWSE and .TWO to .TPEX, then emits the exact requested RuntimeBinding alias in the HTTP view. The official persisted symbol, checksum-derived snapshot id, lineage, and write identity are unchanged.
The paper producer keeps strict exact-symbol admission; a 2330.TW response backed by the official TWSE snapshot now passes that unchanged gate and emits a 2330.TW signal.
The bounded deploy gate reads every active paper snapshot, requires the requested execution identity, an event_time no older than 24 hours, and matching canonical official connector/source lineage.
Root failure diagnostics now capture paper-signal-producer logs plus restart and health state.
not_changed: SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS remains 100 in the release workflow and no max-record bypass exists.
No fixture price, manual SourceRecord write, provider credential, or recurring external egress was added.
RuntimeBinding write authority and paper-signal-producer health thresholds remain unchanged.
The Source snapshot endpoint remains read-only and performs no provider or scheduler work.

assertions: 2330.TW and 2330.TWSE reads retain the same official checksum-derived snapshot id and lineage while exposing their respective requested symbols.
CurrentArtifactStrategy plus the real shared snapshot admission rule accepts the 2330.TW view, preserves official TWSE lineage metadata, and enqueues a 2330.TW paper signal.
